rawContent: Some say the #MeToo movement was killed or damaged by the Heard V Depp case, but I have never seen more support for #MeToo AND #MenToo. Victims, no matter what sex, are being heard more. Let's see that increase even more!

@QuantumCrystal6 I think #MeToo has shown that while men are more physically aggressive, women are more vindictive and petty.
And apparently willing to hurt other women to hurt me.
